summary: Wired Kalani's Landing (Mantis Stronghold, stronghold-wave-816) on Mendon's ruling R-041: after any announced action its controller may target a card in play with a non-zero Gold Cost for -2 Gold Cost until end of turn, once per turn. Also: no Gold when paying for an attachment, and it straightens after each phase begins (new EngineHooks.PhaseBegins channel). The Gold Cost modifier primitive already existed; this adds its target rule, an announce window for either player's action, and the phase hook. SHARED/CROSS-LANE CHANGES: five small hooks into shared rules files (ValidateAbility trigger switch, the announce watcher chain and non-ability announce guard, the announce-window listing in MatchQueries, SetPhase and the hook seal list), each a no-op without the card in the match; one client-lane data file, src/L5R.Client/Content/catalogue-art.json, gains the bundled scan's resources entry (no UI code, no art pixels changed). Mendon's standing authority covers these. Stacked on PR #815 (issue #812), whose files also appear in this branch's diff until #815 merges.
validation: bash tools/check.sh --skip-client passed (Core wave-816: 8 tests covering targets, once per turn, either player's action, Strategy and Equip announced, attachment production and phase straighten; AI soak unchanged); python tools/content unittests pass with the art manifest entry added; tools/lint_comment_swallow clean; art coverage verified offline. No Godot or native client run: rules-only change with no UI change.
remaining: Depends on PR #815 (the card's catalogue record and the art pack catalogue-art-issue812-20261010-r1, which still has to be published as a private release; the receipt in content/catalogue-art-pack.json is #812's, unchanged). Readings for Mendon in docs/decisions/2026-10-10-kalanis-landing.md: Reactions are not announced into this window; a Reserve recruit uses the same route but has no dedicated test; once per game turn number.
